COD.rationale: Content (red at p0/current/n3), an origin/organization entry for the same referent, and a separate content listing are all present with matching referent/time.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify colors ('red'/'blue') bound to explicit referents and coordinate lists.

D.rationale: Content listings (e.g. red coordinates) are provided separately from origin/organization metadata for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: The report specifies how contents are organized/presented (grid orientation, origin/inheritance metadata) for current and candidate entries.
